name: Kitsch
overall: Clearly better than three days ago, and the fixes went where the first review pointed. The label face is solved: Michroma for USER / DESCRIPTION / SECURITY LEVEL / DEVICE SOFTWARE and Krona One for the badge notes read as the reference's wide extended printing at 1600 px, and the mailbox list hierarchy is no longer inverted. The waves are curves, the mailbox list has its rounded fading corner, the fourth store card is cut cleanly, and the dashboard's security-level boxes now match almost exactly. The print overlay is a net gain: there are now soft outward copies around bright marks, close to the reference's halo, on the headers, the logo and the cards. What still separates the two when flipping between them: (1) the second tier of type that the label fix did not reach -- the boxed badge letters A/B/C/D (still a bold condensed letter, tiny and dim on the store), the mailbox tab labels and message title (small and dim), the store's customer block, and the round Gotham-like microcopy face; (2) a few drawing omissions the first review missed -- the dashboard's thin connector lines that join the blades of each fan are absent, and the mailbox warning strip is open at its right end with no crimson fill; (3) surface material -- the reference's fills (ENTER bar, chip tile, yellow tabs, front blades) carry fine grain and glow, ours are flat; and the overlay smears the BRAINDANCE body copy into a doubled look. All judgements are from 1600-pixel images; the type-weight calls are marginal at this size.
regressions: BRAINDANCE panel body copy (dashboard): the print overlay lays a near-solid copy a pixel or two to the right of each line, so the yellow text reads smeared/bold. The reference has a soft hatched glow, not a second copy. Did not exist before the overlay (2026-11-14). Already noted in todo/review-2026-11-13.md section 4 as open.

The overlay's copies are greyer than the reference's: around GUES 7702, the A box and the tab outlines ours leave a neutral grey offset, where the reference's halo is tinted mint/teal. Marginal at 1600 px; reads as dirt rather than glow on the mailbox tab outlines.

Not a regression in the sense of worse than before, but an inconsistency the redraw introduced: the security-level boxes were redrawn on the dashboard (now near-exact, orange 02 on amber) while the mailbox's identical boxes were not -- they still have bold digits and dark brown 02 on saturated yellow.
Michroma, Krona One, the redrawn waves, corners, logo and the dashboard security boxes: no regression seen. Krona One's S reads as 5 at 1600 px (known, clean at 4K).

screens.name: Login
screens.verdict: Still the closest screen, now with the right guest-name weight and a chip mark that reads as the reference's. The barcode and the flat, grain-less fills are what give it away.
matches: Bracket, lobe, input, ENTER bar and both PROTECTED bars sit where the reference puts them, with the right stepped notches; ENTER and PROTECTED are in the wide face.
Chip tile: dark hexagon with its thin teal inner ring and diagonal now matches the reference's mark.
GUEST 7702 is bright mint at the right weight; the Krona One 'access manager' notes match line breaks and extents.
Rose field, its dark sweep inside the bracket and the near-black lower half sample within a few levels of the reference.
Print overlay gives the A box, the name and the clock a soft outward halo like the reference's.

gaps.text: Barcode: ours has heavier, denser, brighter mint bars that read as a solid block; the reference's bars are thinner with more gaps and a softer cyan glow. The digits under it are smaller and more condensed in ours and end ~25 px short; the reference's are larger and wider. The teal side tag lacks the reference's dark printed marks.
Surface material: the reference's ENTER bar, input field and chip tiles carry visible fine grain and a glow bloom; ours are flat fills with a thin halo.

Chip tile left edge: the reference cuts a Y-shaped dark notch with a teal stroke from the hexagon's left vertex down to the bottom-left; ours has a single slanted dark strip at the top-left. Tile colour also slightly greener than the reference's bluer teal.
Footer line is bolder and set in a condensed face; the reference's is lighter and rounder and runs ~23 px further right.

since_2026_11_13.text: All three account logos: the reference draws the hexagon as an outline cut into the teal tile. Ours fills it as a solid dark hexagon.
"GUEST 7702" headings: lighter and greyer than the reference's medium-weight bright mint.
Top-left corner: the reference rose field is pulled back and desaturated there; ours carries rose to the left edge.
The "access manager" microcopy is bolder and more condensed than the reference's wider, lighter printing.

screens.name: Mailbox
screens.verdict: The left list and the header labels are now right; the right-hand column and the message panel's head are where it still differs, mostly in type size and brightness.
matches: Left list: subjects in regular mint and 'from:' lines lighter, the hierarchy now matches; '(!)' reads correctly.
List panel's generous rounded top-left corner with the rule fading out to the right, and the teal wave as a smooth curve, both match.
USER / DESCRIPTION / SECURITY LEVEL in Michroma and the Krona One notes beside the A/B/C boxes match the reference's wide printing.
Header row geometry, GUES 7702 and MAILBOX boxes, the yellow selected row and the message body text (wrap, size, colour) match closely.

gaps.text: Right tab stack (DETAILS / MODS / PRICE / DAMAGE): the reference's labels are larger, medium weight and bright mint (DETAILS dark olive on yellow); ours are about 20% smaller, thinner and dim grey-mint. The tab outlines are also thinner with sharp corners and a grey offset copy, where the reference's are slightly rounded with a mint glow; DETAILS' yellow is duller than the reference's bright gradient. The first review missed this; it is unchanged since then.

Message panel head: the warning strip below the yellow tab is open at its right end -- a lone diagonal stroke with a gap above it -- where the reference closes it with a rounded outline continuing from the tab, and fills the strip with a deeper crimson. The tab title 'YOU'LL REGRET THAT' is about 20% smaller than the reference's. The dashboard's BRAINDANCE strip is closed correctly, so this is mailbox-only.

Security-level boxes: digits are bold where the reference's are medium, and 02 is dark brown on saturated yellow where the reference prints soft orange on a paler amber. The dashboard's identical boxes were fixed; these were not.
Boxed badge letters A/B/C: the reference sets a wide letter filling the box; ours is a narrow bold condensed letter.
Warning-strip microcopy and footer are a bold condensed face; the reference's are a round geometric face (Gotham-like), lighter.
No grain on the yellow fills (selected row, panel tab, DETAILS); the reference's are visibly textured.

screens.question: The tab-stack labels and the message title look about a fifth smaller than the reference in both the old and new renders. Is that a deliberate fit to the trace, or should they be measured against the photo like the list subjects were?

since_2026_11_13.text: Left list: subjects thinner and smaller than the reference; 'from:' lines bold; hierarchy inverted.
Header labels and blurbs (USER, DESCRIPTION, SECURITY LEVEL and the small text beside A/B/C) in bold condensed instead of a thin wide extended face.
Left list panel, top-left corner: tight stepped corner and hard-ended line instead of a generous rounded corner fading out.
Teal wave, bottom-left: visible polygon facets instead of a smooth curve.
The '!' in '(!)' and 'YOU!' reads as 'I'.
Top-right corner: the reference darkens to near-black; ours stays rose.

screens.name: Store
screens.verdict: The wave, the fourth card, the nav and the logo are now right, and the cards were already very good. The corner badge letters and the customer block's type are the visible misses.
matches: Bottom-left teal wave is now a smooth S-curve tapering into a hairline, like the reference.
Fourth card cut cleanly at the right edge; no streaks.
Nav tabs: label weight and size match, selected SMG right; 4ST logo proportions and the outlined T now read as one mark.
Selected card's lower list (20 Recoil ... +2 Modules Slots) is now the reference's size and weight; the three cards, shelf bands, stat bands, sockets and compliance print match.
Corner notes in Krona One now match the reference's bright wide printing.

gaps.text: Corner badge boxes A and C: the reference sets a large, bold, wide letter filling the box, bright teal with a strong glow and a heavier box stroke. Ours is a tiny thin letter in a dim thin box, so both badges nearly vanish.

Customer block ('customer #NC488402', 'loyalty discount 10%', 'last update 10/05/2077'): the reference uses a larger, brighter round sans (Gotham-like); ours is a smaller, dimmer condensed face. The bracket line's right end fades out in the reference and ends hard in ours.

Selected card: the reference's shelf band sits in an outlined frame with a chamfered right end, and the amber fill grades from yellow at the top to orange lower down; ours has a flat fill and a straight band end.
Fourth card: a soft yellow/teal halo spills past the clean cut.
Rose field 15-20 levels darker than the reference at the upper right (x ~1400-1500).

since_2026_11_13.text: Bottom-left teal wave: flatter top, rounded tongue end, no trailing hairline.
Corner blurbs and A/C badges dim grey and condensed instead of teal, wide and glowing.
Fourth card fades through vertical slices that read as streaky pixels.
Selected card lower list too thin with a wide gap; amber silhouette loses internal detail.
Nav tab labels lighter than the reference, tab outlines with sharp corners.
4ST logo: T further from 4S and slightly larger.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.verdict: The security-level boxes and labels are now right and the fans were already excellent; the missing connector lines between blades and the smeared BRAINDANCE body are what remain.
matches: Security-level boxes: rounded corners, even gaps, pale mint outline, orange 02 on amber -- now near-exact (digits marginally bolder).
USER / SECURITY LEVEL / DESCRIPTION / DEVICE SOFTWARE in Michroma and the Krona One notes match.
Both blade fans: angles, ghost-card counts, depth fade and yellow EVENTS match closely.
BRAINDANCE panel: tab, closed warning strip, outline and text wrap match.

gaps.text: Connector lines are missing: in the reference thin mint lines with filleted curves join the blades of each fan -- from the VEHICLES and WEAPONS tips down into PRODUCTS, and from the right PRODUCTS down to EVENTS and LOCATIONS, with a V dip between EVENTS and LOCATIONS. Ours has none, in the old render or the new one; the first review wrongly listed them as matching.
BRAINDANCE body copy is doubled by the print overlay (a near-solid copy to the right of each line), so it reads smeared and bold; the reference's text has a soft hatched glow.
Front blades and the EVENTS blade: the reference's are grained with a brighter glowing outline; ours are flat fills.
BRAINDANCE title is tracked wider and slightly smaller than the reference's; the warning strip lacks the reference's crimson fill and its microcopy is condensed rather than round.
Boxed letters A/C/D/B are bold condensed; the reference's are thin and wide.
Rose field 15-20 levels dark at the upper right (x ~1400-1500, y 100-260).

since_2026_11_13.text: Security level boxes: square teal outlines, 03 and 04 almost touching, dark brown on saturated yellow.
Labels SECURITY LEVEL, DESCRIPTION, USER and DEVICE SOFTWARE bold condensed instead of thin wide-extended.
Top-right corner: the reference vignettes to dark, and the rose field's lower edge curves away more on the right.
Ghost blades: the deeper translucent fills slightly more uniform than the reference.
